title: Homemade salmon nigiri
body: Season the rice with rice vinegar, sugar and salt while it's still warm. Wet your hands, shape small ovals of rice, add a dab of wasabi and top with thin slices of sashimi-grade salmon.

author.bio: Preserving the summer one jar at a time.

title: Quick strawberry jam
body: Simmer 500 g strawberries with 250 g sugar and the juice of half a lemon for about 20 minutes, stirring often. Test on a cold plate: it's done when it wrinkles. Pour into clean jars.

title: Fluffy weekend pancakes
body: Whisk 2 eggs, 3 dl milk, 2.5 dl flour, 1 tbsp sugar, 1 tsp baking powder and a pinch of salt. Rest the batter for 10 minutes, then fry small rounds in butter until golden on both sides.

title: Silky egg drop soup
body: Bring chicken stock to a simmer with ginger and a splash of soy sauce. Thicken slightly with cornstarch, then slowly pour in beaten eggs while stirring gently. Finish with spring onion and sesame oil.

title: Loaded veggie hot dogs
body: Grill plant-based sausages until charred. Toast the buns, then top with sauerkraut, pickled red onion, crispy fried onions and a stripe of mustard and ketchup.
